newsitem.title: UK: FTSE 100 builds on Dow-led gains, trades up 50 pts.
newsitem.headline: FTSE 100 builds on Dow-led gains, trades up 50 pts.

text.p: ** FTSE 100 extends early Dow-led rise, pushed further by
** Wall Street seen opening higher on follow-through from
Tuesday's 173-point rally and bolstered by steady bonds.
By 1310 GMT the FTSE 100 was 48.4 ahead at 4,394.5, having touched 4,396.1.
Trading activity is still low amid uncertainty over the May 1 election result and the prospect for interest rates after the election.
Buoying sentiment, but not boosting trade, was an ICM/Guardian poll showing opposition Labour's lead over the ruling Conservatives had narrowed to only five points.
Topping the most heavily traded shares was Alliance & Leicester with nearly 60 million traded as institutions scrambled to pick up stock.
Bank of Scotland was also heavily traded after full year results news which left the shares just a penny up at 339p. Nearly 10 million shares changed hands.
Bucking the trend, Pearson fell 9-1/2p to 719p in thin volume.
